subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Supplier Evaluation
description: A quick, practical guide to Supplier Evaluation.

hook.text: A supplier promised 99% on-time delivery. After six months, the actual rate was 74%. Nobody checked.

buildup.text: Supplier evaluation assesses potential and current suppliers on quality, cost, delivery, and capability.

discovery.text: Scorecards track key metrics. Site audits verify what scorecards can't—factory conditions and real capacity.

twist.text: Evaluating only on price ignores quality, reliability, and innovation. The cheapest supplier often costs the most.

climax.text: Companies with formal supplier evaluation programs report 30% fewer supply disruptions.

punchline.text: Measure your suppliers or they'll surprise you—badly.

quiz.question: What should supplier evaluation include beyond price?
